leverage.zh:
标签：清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：月初约 +4.53%/yr → 期末约 +9.31%/yr，租金全月抬升；OI 月变约 -1.41%（109543 → 108003），库存月内回落，偏去杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 08-21（2026-08-21）；峰值约 11.13× 月内中位清算量；价格同日约 +7.3%；当日 OI 约 106118；但 OI 月高在 2026-08-14（约 112008），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-08-22：OI 自峰值日回落至约 105834、funding 年化约 +10.95%/yr、价格约 -1.6%。 side 语义未核验，此处只并陈结构，不判多空谁爆。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：月合计约 3081.19 亿美金，环比约 +13.0%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线路径 + 出清线「峰值双高/事件尖峰」共同支撑「清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。 side 语义未核验，只并陈结构。
leverage.en:
Label: liquidation_driven_squeeze.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+4.53%/yr → ~+9.31%/yr — rent rose over the month; OI month change ~-1.41% (109543 → 108003), inventory down on the month — lean deleveraging.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-08-21; peak ~11.13× median liq qty; price that day ~+7.3%; OI that day ~106118; OI month-high was 2026-08-14 (~112008), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-08-22: OI eased to ~105834; funding ~+10.95%/yr; price ~-1.6%. Side semantics unverified — structure only, no long/short blame.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): month sum ~308.12B, WoW ~+13.0%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: lines ①–③ check whether label “liquidation_driven_squeeze” holds; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

vol_teach.zh: 先分清两个「波动」：RV（已实现/历史波动）是后视镜——价格已经抖得有多厉害；IV（隐含波动率）是保险报价——期权市场觉得未来会抖多厉害。RV 偏高 = 刚走过的路很颠；RV 偏低 = 最近相对平静。IV 偏高 = 保险贵，市场愿为未来不确定性付更高价；IV 偏低 = 保险便宜。IV 持续抬升 = 保费在变贵；IV 回落 = 紧张定价在缓解。RV 抬头 = 实现波动在升温；RV 回落 = 颠簸在缓和。二者同向升温 = 又颠又贵；同向降温 = 整体变稳。IV 升而 RV 不高 = 预期/谨慎溢价可能先行；RV 高而 IV 降 = 实现仍猛但保费在退或滞后。核心看 IV−RV：保险相对「刚实现的颠簸」贵了还是便宜了。以下只描述环境，不是买卖建议。
vol_teach.en: Two vols, not one: RV (realized) is the rear-view mirror—how rough price already was; IV (implied) is the insurance quote—how rough the options market prices the future. High RV = the road just traveled was bumpy; low RV = recent calm. High IV = expensive insurance; low IV = cheap insurance. Rising IV = insurance getting dearer; falling IV = stress premium easing. Rising RV = realized heat building; falling RV = bumps cooling. Both up = rough and expensive; both down = regime cooling. IV up / RV not extreme = caution or event premium may lead; RV hot / IV down = realized still fierce but insurance lagging or fading. Key gauge: IV−RV—rich or cheap insurance vs just-realized moves. Environment only—not trade advice.

vol_week.zh: 本期 BTC：RV（后视镜）窗口年化约 41.5%；IV（Deribit 保险报价）期末约 37.6%，自基点 35.6% 小幅抬升（+2.0 个百分点）。 ETH：IV 51.3% / RV 66.9%。
vol_week.en: This month BTC: RV (rear-view) ~41.5% ann.; IV (Deribit insurance) end ~37.6%; from baseline 35.6% edged up (+2.0 pct pts). ETH: IV 51.3% / RV 66.9%.

vol_combo.zh: IV 升而 RV 并未同步极高：保险在加价，但「刚实现的颠簸」还没那么夸张——偏谨慎/事件溢价或预期先行。 IV−RV 约 -3.9 个百分点：贵贱大致匹配。
vol_combo.en: IV up while RV is not extreme: insurance re-priced higher before (or beyond) just-realized roughness. IV−RV ≈ -3.9 pct pts: roughly fair vs realized.

vol_price_iv.zh: 本月价涨且 IV 也升：上涨并未让保险费降温，定价仍在为不确定性付费。
vol_price_iv.en: Price up + IV up: the rally did not cool option insurance; uncertainty is still being priced.

vol_vix.zh: 加密 IV 与 VIX（-9.8%）方向背离：币圈期权定价与美股紧张度未同步。仍勿把 VIX 读成加密 IV。
vol_vix.en: Crypto IV diverged from VIX (-9.8%): option stress in crypto is not tracking US equities. Still never read VIX as crypto IV.

three_conclusions.zh: 本月 BTC/ETH 收在强趋势上涨，并与股指温和收高、VIX 回落构成同向 risk-on，月度主线是风险偏好扩张而非加密独自脱钩。
three_conclusions.en: BTC/ETH closed the month in a strong uptrend alongside milder equity gains and a softer VIX—risk-on sync, not crypto-only decoupling.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆侧的清算峰值与中段加速同向，更像上涨段挤压痕迹；费率正、OI 略降，仓位总量并未随涨幅失控膨胀。
three_conclusions.en: Liquidation peaks aligned with the mid-month thrust, reading more as upside squeeze texture; funding positive, OI slightly down—positioning did not balloon unchecked with price.

three_conclusions.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 本月强流入（约 +35.39 亿美金）与 ETH ETF 净流入并陈，现货通道与正常偏热的成交一起，构成与趋势月同向的流动性背景（并不焊死因果）。
three_conclusions.en: US spot BTC ETFs’ strong monthly inflow (~+3.54B USD) plus ETH ETF nets, beside normally warm turnover, form a liquidity backdrop aligned with the trend month (correlation noted, causation not welded).

The prior month’s milder advance gave way this month to a steeper trend leg and a much thicker spot channel.
